title: Six Hundred Twenty-Four Channels
summary: The nineteen non-negative integer points of x² + y² + z² = 867, lifted to a 25-state shell: twelve lifted states give four readings and twelve give six, so two ordered comparisons make 12 × 4² + 12 × 6² = 624 directed channels (computed); an inversion of thresholds generated by this model recovers a gain inside (623.91, 624.09) (replay certificate on model data). Confined to shell edges with d² ≤ 56, 216 channels are stuck; through the 1/3-grid all return in the least possible 9 steps, and 4 + 4 + 9 makes a 17-tick feedback cycle; reusing those edges for mass with the old block fixed raises every candidate's mass reading by more than 3.163 × 10⁻⁵ (certificates). Lean checks two algebraic anchors: the exact image of two-hidden-scalar Schur responses (β and ε nonzero force γ nonzero), and the full dimension classification of width-three Kronecker-sum Gram isotropy, drawn as a staircase 2/3, 1/2, 1/3 in c/d against b/a. The local memory rank falls from 38 (fixed block) to 24 at D = 392, 23 at 544, then 21, 20 and a floor of 19 (replay certificates, not Lean). Lean checks with zero axioms that the twelve projective representatives of the 24-element Hurwitz core have doubled squared norm 4; sixteen-step norm-five words reach the coupling box and match no zero, the first single matching word has 21 steps (certificate). Different model-internal criteria crown #10875, #11737, #11488, #11431 and #11618, three copies exactly protect a qutrit against one shared unread zero (certificate), and no single law yet selects the zero.
summary_zh: x² + y² + z² = 867 的十九个非负整点提升为二十五态球壳：十二个提升态各有 4 种读数、另十二个各有 6 种，两次有序比较给出 12 × 4² + 12 × 6² = 624 条定向通道（屏幕计算）；用这个模型生成的阈值数据反演，增益落在 (623.91, 624.09) 内（模型数据上的复算证书）。只沿 d² ≤ 56 的壳边走有 216 条通道被困；借道三分之一细分格，全部通道在最少的 9 步内回程，4 + 4 + 9 合成十七拍反馈周期；固定旧块而把这些边复用于质量传播，每枚候选的质量读数都被抬高超过 3.163 × 10⁻⁵（证书）。Lean 内核检验两条代数锚点：双隐藏标量舒尔响应的精确像（β、ε 非零迫使 γ 非零），以及宽度三克罗内克和 Gram 等距的全维数分类，画成 c/d 对 b/a 的 2/3、1/2、1/3 阶梯。局部记忆秩从固定旧块的 38 降到 D = 392 处的 24、544 处的 23，再到 21、20 与地板 19（复算证书，不是 Lean）。Lean 内核在零公理下检验二十四元赫维茨晶核的十二个射影代表加倍模方恒为 4；16 步范数五词能进耦合盒却不匹配任何零点，第一条单独匹配的词为 21 步（证书）。不同的模型内准则分别选出 #10875、#11737、#11488、#11431 与 #11618；同一枚未读零点下三份副本恰好零误差保护一个三态量子信息（证书）；仍没有一条定律选定零点。
